Condolences climb for Covington pilot killed in Iraq
item.description: Condolences continue to mount for Capt. Ariana Savino, 31, of Covington, one of six U.S. airmen killed when their KC-135 refueling aircraft crashed in western Iraq during the war against Iran.

item.title: The face of war | Greg Asimakoupoulos
item.description: The day after Israel and the United States dropped bombs on Iran, I was watching coverage of the conflict on my television. A most disturbing image caught my attention. In the smoke rising above the smoldering debris, I saw the image of a face. I grabbed my iPhone and snapped a photo. I wondered if anyone else viewing this coverage of the war saw what I saw.
